scenarios.name: normal_operation
scenarios.description: 正常 Redis Cache 操作场景：创建 Redis → 设置键值 → 获取键 → 列出密钥 → 删除
commands: az redis create --name test-redis --resource-group test-rg --location eastus --sku Basic --vm-size c0
az redis set --name test-redis --resource-group test-rg --key test-key --value 'Hello World'
az redis get --name test-redis --resource-group test-rg --key test-key

scenarios.name: partial_failure
scenarios.description: 部分失败场景：Redis 创建成功但获取键失败
commands: az redis create --name fail-redis --resource-group test-rg --location eastus --sku Basic --vm-size c0
az redis get --name fail-redis --resource-group test-rg --key nonexistent-key

scenarios.name: full_failure
scenarios.description: 完全失败场景：Redis 实例不存在
